name: Poems
description: A collection of poems: a title page and dedication, the contents, each poem an element with its lines written as verse, then acknowledgements and a note on the poet.

source.name: The parts of a published collection of poems, as the poetry layout has it
source.notes: Each poem is an element under the collection, its name the title; the acknowledgements name where the poems first appeared. No publisher's page is reproduced.
